propositions: test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml hand-copy identical gate+suite command sets, creating drift risk policed by test_ci_workflow_parity.py
A single reusable workflow_call file _build-and-test.yml should consolidate the shared lint, pip-audit, and test jobs, parameterized by gerrit-refspec for checkout logic
Both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must delegate to _build-and-test.yml instead of duplicating the gate definitions, eliminating the source of copy-sync drift

Five existing safety invariants in test_ci_workflow_parity.py must be preserved: gate existence, script asymmetry, precommit hook skipping, redundant hook skipping, and optionality contract; three must be retargeted at the reusable, two rewritten as delegation checks
The refactored reusable path (branch-head lane via test.yml post-merge) must produce identical gate coverage to the current inline gerrit-verify.yaml build-and-test job
